note_tweet.text:
Everyone's talking about AI agents & if you want to build, here is where to start.

1. n8n:
> a workflow builder 
> you draw every step: trigger → action → action. 
>AI can sit inside a step but the path is fixed.

Use it when a business process must run the same way every time like lead follow-ups, invoices.

2. OpenClaw & Hermes: 
>open-source agents
>you give a goal 
>the AI picks the tools and the order
>run on your own laptop or server

Use them when you want a personal assistant you fully control, wired to WhatsApp or Telegram.

3. Grok Bot, Claude Duet, Meta Muse, OpenAI Dots: 

>the same idea
>run by the big labs 
>each agent gets its own cloud computer
>no setup, just pay & use

Use them when you want it working today and don't want to manage a server.

On when to use each tool;
>Fixed steps → n8n

>AI decides, you host it → OpenClaw / Hermes

>AI decides, they host it → Grok Bot / Duet
